verdict.rationale: Pulley's compliance product page says the software handles 'ASC 718 reporting' for finance teams, so the capability is first-party. That is a single marketing line with no help-center documentation of how expense reports are generated, what they contain, or whether they are auditor-ready. The 409A audit-defensibility claim concerns valuations, not ASC 718 expense reporting, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of ASC 718 expense report generation and its contents (e.g., fair-value inputs, expense amortization schedules, forfeiture handling), export formats for accountants, evidence that reports satisfy auditors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
